manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift the rounded mug with glossy shine from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the medium-sized rack.

Task description: The object is the glossy black round cup left of center on the table; the target is the light-colored medium rack on the right. The task involves lifting, rotating, and lowering the cup, then hanging it on the rack.

Success criteria: The cup hangs on the right rack, horizontally near its middle target area and raised to the rod's hanging height, clear of the table. The right gripper is open and has released it.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a rim-wall section away from the mug handle with one finger inside and one outside. Match the opening to local thickness and available space, leaving room to fit the handle over the rod.
- Before closing, confirm that the pads are truly on the inside and outside of the cup wall and cover a short section below the rim, rather than touching only the rim or relying on image overlap.
- When rotating the cup, leave clearance between the base and table and between the cup body and post. If a regrasp is needed, first set the base down securely before releasing the current grasp.
- To hang the cup, face the handle hole toward the slanted rod's free end away from the post and adjust along the rod, avoiding early collision of cup or fingers with the rack. Before release, lower slightly so the inner handle rests on the rod.
